title: Release readiness — weekly scratchpad (go/no-go prep)
content:
Meeting: Release Train — weekly go/no-go prep (personal scratchpad)
Owner: Maya Chen
Goal: Quick triage of outstanding launch blockers, sync owners, prepare decision brief for Friday RT meeting.
Date for this note: 2026-03-10 (week of sanity checks)

Quick context (to self):
- Prod rollout candidate: v2.4.1 with batching+KV cache improvements on serving runtime.
- Target window: next Tuesday night (region us-west-2 first wave).
- Key impact areas: latency p99, token cost delta (~12%), canary traffic profile.

Agenda (what I want to cover in the weekly):
1) Status of critical blockers (deploy, infra, canary, QA)
2) Safety/compliance signoff status (privacy team)
3) Performance benchmarks vs SLO targets (p50/p95/p99)
4) Rollout plan: canary thresholds + automatic rollback params
5) Escalation path and on-call coverage for rollout window
6) Final owners for go/no-go items + explicit acceptance criteria

Checklist (go/no-go items) — quick single-line statuses. Marked: OK / WIP / BLOCKER
- Infra capacity pre-provisioned in us-west-2: OK (infra confirmed reservation, tagged)
- Dedicated GPU quantization validation tests: WIP (Alex running nightly, 60% green)
- Canary telemetry pipeline (traces + cost) hooked into Console: WIP (missing token-level cost for embeddings)
- Privacy/KMS review completed for customer data flow: OK (Priya signed off 2026-03-08)
- Rolling rollback automation tested: BLOCKER (rollback script fails on multi-tenant routing, need patch)
- DB migrations (schema shrink) — backwards-compatible: OK (no outage expected)
- Feature flags in place for immediate disable of new batching: OK
- Smoke tests coverage for long chats (>2k tokens): WIP (QA test RT-22 flaky)

Owners & concrete next steps (who to ping before Friday meeting):
- Alex Novak: finish quantization validation (action: stabilize nightly; due 2026-03-12).
- SRE on-call (pager duty): verify rollback script; temp owner: Samir (action: debug and prepare hotfix; due 2026-03-11 EOD).
- Priya Desai (privacy): confirm KMS rotation window doesn't overlap deploy; she already acked, but re-confirm on Friday.
- Console team: add token-level cost to canary dashboard (action: add metric + alert; owner: Lina; due 2026-03-13).
- QA lead (Jared): resolve RT-22 smoke flakiness; add deterministic seeds to test harness (due 2026-03-12).

Open risks (talk points for the meeting):
- Rollback automation instability is highest risk: without safe rollback we should not do wide rollout. Need clear escalation path if rollback fails.
- Cost increase (12%): product must sign off that temporary cost hit acceptable for first week OR we enable burst mode limited to reserved accounts.
- Long-chat memory regression: if KV cache misses are higher, latency p99 could exceed SLO. Must verify test coverage across chat lengths.

Decision matrix (how I want the RT to decide on Friday):
- If rollback automation fixed and quantization tests >= 90% green and canary p99 <= 1.5x baseline: GO for canary (10% traffic).
- If rollback automation NOT fixed OR any BLOCKER remains: HOLD (delay by 1 week or do manual canary with heavy guardrails).
- If canary metrics show >2x p99 or errors spike by >0.5% absolute -> AUTO ROLLBACK (we must ensure rollback path is robust beforehand).

Notes to self / prep script for Friday brief:
- 60s summary: current status, top 2 risks (rollback, long-chat reg), recommendation (canary if rollback fixed & quant ok).
- One-slide evidence: morning perf dashboard screenshot + quantization pass rate + QA smoke passrate.
- Have the rollback command sequence typed and tested in staging — bring step-by-step in case we need it live.

Action items captured here (personal tracker):
- [ ] Ping Samir and allocate 2 hrs tomorrow to reproduce rollback failure locally. (Maya)
- [ ] Slack ping to Alex for nightly logs and ask for root-cause if failures >3. (Maya)
- [ ] Draft 60s brief for Friday and drop in #release-train by EOD Thursday. (Maya)
- [ ] Attach cost sensitivity table to the brief: show 0%, +5%, +12% scenarios and customer impact. (Maya + Product)
- [ ] Confirm on-call rotation for deploy window (2 AM - 6 AM PST). (Maya)

Meeting prep checklist (what I need on my laptop before meeting):
- Latest canary dashboard (console link) open
- Quantization nightly summary (artifacts from CI)
- Logs from rollback attempt (Samir’s node)
- Short script to trigger manual rollback (tested in staging)

Misc notes / fragments (unsorted):
- Can we do a rolling canary by tenant group instead of percent? Might reduce blast radius for top customers. Follow-up: check policy code in runtime for tenant routing. (ticket: RT-4178)
- Consider temporarily enabling caching TTL shorter for low-value tokens to reduce cost spike. Quick experiment? (ask infra)
- If we delay, what's the new date? +1 week minimum to give SRE time. Need to communicate to Sales for customers in upcoming demos.

Tagged slack threads / artifacts to review before call:
- Slack: #release-train thread "rollback fail log" (pinned)
- GH PR: runtime/pull/678 (contains batching metrics changes)
- JIRA: RT-4123 (canary plan), RT-4178 (tenant routing change)
